title: Harbor & Pine Dental: booking site
stuck: A nice-looking site that brought in few bookings. New patients had to call during office hours, and many never did.
now: One clear 'Book an appointment' button. Patients book day or night, and every booking goes straight into the calendar, with no calls to answer.

title: Automatic lead follow-up
stuck: Every enquiry waited until the owner had a free moment. Some waited a day, and those customers booked elsewhere.
now: Every new lead gets a personal reply in under a minute and is saved to the customer list. The owner reads one short summary instead of every message.
